newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on overnight dollar weakness.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on overnight dollar weakness.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar and pound on Wednesday, commercial banks forex dealers said.
The rupee traded at a mean rate of 19.9665 against the dollar from 20.0035 on Tuesday. The rupee was quoted at a mean rate of 33.0455 versus the pound from 33.0955 on Tuesday.
Dealers said the rupee's fixing against the dollar on Wednesday reflected a weaker U.S. currency overnight.
"On the local front, things are quiet as we are not getting much demand from importers," one dealer said.
"And after the central bank sold dollars in its intervention on Monday, commercial banks now look like being comfortable with their foreign exchange reserves," the dealer added.
